purpose: Issue-04 application input contract 2026-10-27: unknown/omitted/null/empty clinical inputs estimate with missing/null context and disclosed uncertainty; not_assessed/Unresolved/conflict/invalid and follow-up baseline/trial prerequisites still need clarification. No new clinical approval.

fields.definition: Scenario preference for an LAI or oral treatment
fields.source_locator: Patient Preferences — shared decision-making; pluses and minuses of LAIs reviewed; prior LAI experience
fields.operationalization: PrefersLAI/PrefersOral require documented shared discussion of pluses and minuses. Undecided means the patient has not settled a preference after discussion and is a known explicit value that still executes. DeclinesLAI means explicit decline and still executes with a preference-respecting review. Absent or uncertain discussion (unknown/not_assessed/missing/conflict) pauses for clarification and is never coerced to PrefersOral or DeclinesLAI. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.source_locator: STATEMENT 10: Long-Acting Injectable Antipsychotic Medications — prefer LAI if poor or uncertain adherence; discussions often occur with difficulty adhering to oral medications
fields.operationalization: Poor means clinician identifies difficulty adhering to oral medications or breaks in continuity. Adequate means review found no identified adherence concern. Unknown assessment pauses; legacy Uncertain is converted to unattributed Unknown. Page notes are never mapping input.
